about.title: There is always someone on the other end
about.lead: Kamil builds and runs the technical side. Younes runs the commercial side and the numbers. Fatima organizes everything else.
body: Younes negotiates with suppliers, controls budgets and steps into the technical side when needed: accounting, data analysis, programming. He has run teams of fifty and purchasing operations across three continents.
Fatima runs the agenda, the documentation, the marketing and the copy, in four languages. When you write, she makes sure nobody leaves you without an answer.

We work with businesses of 1 to 100 people, in Spain and abroad. In Madrid we come in person when the job calls for it: a server that never reaches the internet, an office where we need to see the setup.
This page is built the way we build yours: no templates, no trackers, nothing loading from outside, and the code sitting in the open on GitHub.

faq.title: What people ask before hiring us

items.a: Yes. The number on each service includes VAT and the whole job. If your case needs less, we take out what you won't use and the number drops. The final number goes in writing in the scope sheet.
One to seven days once we have your material: text, logo and access. A simple site lands in two. A migration with mail and certificates runs to five or seven. The exact date goes in the scope sheet.
Outside this website, by bank transfer or Bizum, once you approve the work. We issue an invoice with full tax details. This page takes no payments and stores no banking data.

items.q: What does each maintenance plan cover?
items.a: The number is flat per month per client, whether we maintain one server or five. Care applies patches, watches the service and fixes what breaks. Protected adds backups with tested restoration and alerts. Critical adds priority response and hours for small jobs.
Yes. The domain registers in your name, the code gets handed to you and the hosting sits in your account. Tomorrow you can take everything without asking us.

items.q: I pay a monthly fee for a tool. Can you get rid of it?
items.a: Sometimes. We check whether an equivalent exists that you can host yourself. If it does, we set it up and charge three months of that fee. If it doesn't, we say so and charge nothing. We stay away from invoicing and anything with a legal obligation attached.

items.q: What do you need from me to start?
items.a: The text you want to show, your logo if you have one, and access to the domain if you already bought it. If you have none of that, we write a first draft and you correct it.
Remotely, with clients in Spain and abroad. In Madrid we come in person when the job needs it: a server that doesn't reach the internet, an office where we need to see the setup.

items.q: I already have a website and I don't want to change it
items.a: Then look at the migration or the review. We can shift what you have to a cheaper server, or tell you where it sits exposed, without touching the design.

items.q: What do you do with my data?
items.a: We keep your name and your contact so we can reply, nothing else. We sell no data, run no advertising and set no tracking. The privacy policy spells it out.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what data I collect, what I use it for and how you get it deleted. Written to be understood.
summary: I only collect what you type into the contact form.
I use it to reply to you and for nothing else.
No tracking cookies, no analytics, no third-party fonts.
Ask me to delete it and I delete it.

p: Controller: {legalName}
Tax ID: {taxId}
Contact: {email}
From the contact form: the name you type, the description of what you need, and the email or phone you leave.
I collect no browsing data. This site installs no analytics or advertising cookies, loads no third-party fonts or scripts, and uses no tracking pixels.
The server hosting the page records your IP address in its technical logs, which happens on any web server and serves the security of the service.

sections.h: What I use it for and on what legal basis
p: I use your data to answer your enquiry and, if you hire me, to run the job and issue the invoice.
The legal basis is your consent when you tick the box on the form, and performance of a contract once we start working together. Invoicing records get kept because the law requires it.
If we never end up working together, I delete your enquiry after {retention} months.
If you hire me, I keep the invoicing data for the periods Spanish tax law requires.
The form gets processed by {processorName}, with servers in the United States. That provider receives the form content in order to pass it to me by email. You can read their policy on their own site.
Hosting is handled by {hostingProvider}.
I sell your data to nobody and share it with nobody else. There are no advertisers.

sections.h: If you would rather skip the form
p: Write to {email}, call, or send a WhatsApp message. That way your data never passes through the form provider.
You can ask me for access to your data, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, portability, and you can object to processing. Write to {email} and I answer within one month.
If you believe I have not complied, you can complain to the {authority}.

This site sets no cookies. It stores one technical value in your browser: the language you pick, so it stops asking. That value never leaves your device, identifies nobody, and you clear it by clearing site data in your browser.
That is why you see no cookie banner: there is nothing to consent to.
